articles.summary: Janus Living, Inc. (NYSE: JAN) (“Janus Living”), a pure-play senior housing real estate investment trust (REIT), is scheduled to report third quarter 2026 financial results after the close of trading on the New York Stock Exchange on Monday, November 2, 2026. Janus Living will host a conference call and webcast on Tuesday, November 3, 2026 at 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time to review its financial performance and operating results. The conference call can be accessed in the following ways: Janus Living’s website: https://ir.janusreit.com/events-and-presentations Webcast: https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/324806552 . Joining via webcast is recommended for those who will not be asking questions. Telephone: The participant dial-in number is (833) 461-5787. The international dial-in is (585) 542-9983. The conference ID number is 324 806 552. A webcast replay will be available on Janus Living’s website through December 3, 2026. ABOUT JANUS LIVING Janus Living, Inc. is a pure-play senior housing
articles.title: Janus Living Announces Dates of Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release, Conference Call, and Webcast
